$comment: Pinned public projects for runs that are comparable over time and across machines (CI runs these). Fields: repo and sha: what `pnpm arena corpus setup` clones into corpus/<name>/; install: steps run in the checkout, in order, without a shell: {run: [program, ...args]} or {copy: [from, to]} where {fixtures} is fixtures/corpus/; configs: the configs checked, relative to the checkout, matching the project's own typecheck command; source: where that command comes from. A project is only timed where the reference reports no errors on it.

projects.name: type-fest
projects.description: A type-level library; almost all of its check cost is its own test-d suite
projects.installNote: type-fest commits no lockfile; the fixture, from danfry1/ts-checker-bench (MIT), pins its dependency tree.
